systems.label: App purchases
systems.description: The in-app paywall and subscriptions on iPhone and Android: Apple/Google purchases through RevenueCat, restore purchases, web-subscriber redemption.

systems.label: App reminders & widgets
systems.description: Push notifications, reminder scheduling, home-screen widgets, Siri shortcuts and quick actions in the mobile app.

systems.label: App onboarding & sign-in
systems.description: First-run flow in the mobile app: welcome screens, onboarding versions (v10/v11), sign in with Apple/Google/email, setup.

systems.label: Mobile app
systems.description: The Ripple iPhone/Android app (Expo): recording a Debrief, home, tasks, habits, goals, insights, Life Matrix, settings.

systems.label: Shared code
systems.description: Code both the web and mobile apps use: pricing plans, free-tier rules, habit rules, progression, copy and theme.

systems.label: Legendary Mythicals
systems.description: The third brand: daily 'which one is you?' fantasy video posts (Kling clips + music), YouTube Shorts, legendarymythicals.com and its quiz.

systems.label: Jev (judge & ranker)
systems.description: The decision layer: drafts several options, sense-checks them, ranks with the weekly brief, and recalibrates against real post performance.

systems.label: Research engine
systems.description: Weekly competitor and niche research: scrapes competitors (Apify), Reddit and hashtags, then writes briefs that feed posts and ads.

systems.label: Social content factory
systems.description: Makes and posts the daily Ripple and BWK content: carousels, pick posts, lists, animated covers, reels and voiced videos, then auto-posts to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and TikTok and tracks how they do.

systems.label: AdLab (Meta ads)
systems.description: The paid ads engine: writes and generates ads, launches them on Meta in their own ad sets, applies the cost-per-trial verdict rules daily, and researches competitor ads.

systems.label: UGC & creators
systems.description: Creator partnerships: the creator platform (referral links, 25% revenue share, payouts) and UGC ad tooling.
systems.statusNote: Creator scraping/outreach retired 10-21 (Keenan uses a ChatGPT agent); UGC ad tooling and creator payouts still live.

systems.label: SEO & blog
systems.description: Search traffic: the auto-blog (writes, refreshes and prunes posts), comparison and 'best app' pages, the research data page, sitemap, Google Search Console.

systems.label: Founder reports
systems.description: What lands in Keenan and Jimmy's inboxes and Slack: the nightly 'Ripple today' email, the Saturday weekly digest, signup/payment alerts.

systems.label: User emails & push
systems.description: Emails and notifications to users: trial countdown, payment-failed, win-back, recovery, drips, weekly digest, reminders, release announcements.

systems.label: Payments & subscriptions
systems.description: Who has paid and what they can use: Stripe checkout and webhooks, Apple/Google receipts, RevenueCat, entitlements, pricing and the price test.

systems.label: Tracking & attribution
systems.description: Where signups came from and what they did: Meta pixel + Conversions API, PostHog, GA4, ad attribution, onboarding events, internal-traffic filtering.

systems.label: Web signup funnel
systems.description: The path from an ad to a paid trial on the web: /start and test funnels, the A/B split, quiz screens, first Debrief, password step, paywall and checkout handoff.

systems.label: Debrief processing
systems.description: What happens after someone records: upload, transcription, then AI pulls out tasks, mood, themes and people, and the result is shown back.

systems.label: Insights & reports
systems.description: The 'what's really going on' layer: weekly report, State of Me, Life Audit, Life Matrix, patterns, people, memory, lifts & drains.

systems.label: Habits, tasks & goals
systems.description: Turning words into action: tasks and task groups, habits and streaks, goals, achievements, progression and plan-my-day.

systems.label: Calendar sync
systems.description: Two-way sync of tasks with Google/Apple calendars.

systems.label: AI connectors (MCP)
systems.description: Lets people connect Ripple to Claude/ChatGPT (MCP server + OAuth) and export to Obsidian.

systems.label: Web app
systems.description: The signed-in Ripple website: home, entries, account, settings, and the shared app shell and UI pieces.

systems.label: Accounts & sign-in
systems.description: Sign-up, sign-in (email code, password, Apple, Google), sessions, account deletion.

systems.label: Admin dashboard
systems.description: This dashboard: Command Center, funnel and business metrics, users, AI costs, settings and the admin tools.

systems.label: Marketing site
systems.description: goripple.io's public pages: homepage, why, roadmap, what's new, privacy/terms/support, testimonials and positioning copy.

systems.label: Core platform
systems.description: The plumbing everything sits on: database client, background jobs (Inngest), feature flags, rate limits, logging, error tracking.
